subject: c-info
title: C.INFO.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 84 ((AF)D-12). C-INFO (composite information) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: TH-CONT (thrust continuance), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From PROG-CONT: CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) and SOC-RT (social reality). From TH-CONT: PROG-CONT and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From CULT-INFO-DY: EXT-F (extended functionalism) and MT-INFO (multi-information), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". From T-C-IMP: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From MT-INFO: BIA (bi-aitional). From BIA: AFD. From AFD: PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
